newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Telecom to sell Pac Star Mobile for A$4.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Telecom to sell Pac Star Mobile for A$4.5 mln.

text.p: Telecom Corp of New Zealand said on Thursday it intends to enter into a conditional agreement to sell Pacific Star Mobile Pty Ltd to CXA Communications Ltd.
The consideration for the sale is A$4.5 million, to be satisfied by the issue of CXA shares, Telecom said in a statement.
Pacific Star Mobile is a service provider for Telstra Mobilenet and operates out of Perth with outlets in Sydney, Brisbane and Perth.
Telecom said the sale had the consent of Telstra.
CXA has business interests in the areas of message handling, software development, paging products and radio communication products as well as cellular mobile phone products.
"CXA will utilise its current Telecell distribution chain to ensure a high level of connectivity to Telstra Mobilenet via Pacific Star Mobile," Telecom said.
